Students will understand how to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.
Students will understand how to conduct and promote ethical and responsible research.

Students will develop and implement strategies for evaluating research progress and outcomes for team members.
Students will guide students in dissemination through publications, presentations, or other scholarly activities.
